job: Standard garage Type 06 - Rendered double garage in Nudura ICF

stages.title: Raft slab
stages.desc: Indicative 200 RC raft with a 600 x 450 thickened edge under the ICF, on DPM and 150 hardcore (engineer to design).

stages.title: Nudura ICF walls
stages.desc: Nudura 6in Standard on Nudura Bond, 6,483 x 6,077 outside - webs on the grid from both corners, NO stack joints; eaves walls 5 courses to the plate, gables raked to the roof; garage door with a one-course lintel, personnel door and windows on course lines. Every form as it would be laid.

stages.title: Roof structure
stages.desc: Trussed rafters (fink) @600 with binders, gable ladders (indicative).

stages.title: Roof membrane + battens
stages.desc: Breathable roofing membrane and 25 x 50 treated battens.

stages.title: Tiles, fascia, soffit + rainwater goods
stages.desc: Marley Modern smooth grey concrete interlocking tiles, every tile drawn in broken bond, half-round dry ridge, dry verge, PVC-u fascia / soffit / 22 x 225 barge boards, half-round gutters + downpipes.

stages.title: Windows + doors
stages.desc: Anthracite (RAL 7016) window(s), composite personnel door, electric roller garage door (supplier).

stages.title: Opening tapes
stages.desc: Tremco CPG illbruck ME110 internal window membrane round every opening (garage door excluded).

stages.title: Dryvit 500 render
stages.desc: Dryvit 500 thin-coat render (Tremco CPG), 7.5 build-up, direct to the Nudura EPS, into the reveals to the frames.
